historical_record.description: The property was a single-family house, which the San Francisco Unified School District proposed to buy for the play yard of a rebuilt Bryant Elementary School.

The City Planning Commission unanimously found the School District's purchase of the house, for the kindergarten and child-care play yard of a rebuilt Bryant Elementary School, in conformity with the Master Plan, provided displaced residents were offered relocation services.
